schema.text: Which of the following situations on a trip do you consider unsafe? (the most important)

options.text: Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure (e.g. sidewalks, crossings, cycle paths, lighting)
Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. potholes, debris, uneven surfaces)
Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, or pedestrians
Crowding or conflicts with other road users
I don't feel unsafe at all

en.#Which of the following situations on a: Which of the following situations on a trip do you consider unsafe? (the most important)
en.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure (e.g. sidewalks, crossings, cycle paths, lighting)
en.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. potholes, debris, uneven surfaces)
en.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, or pedestrians
en.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Crowding or conflicts with other road users
en.#I don't feel unsafe at all: I don't feel unsafe at all

it.#Which of the following situations on a: Quali delle seguenti situazioni durante uno spostamento consideri pericolose? (le più importanti)
it.#Heavy or fast-moving traffic: Traffico intenso o ad alta velocità
it.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Mancanza di infrastrutture sicure o adeguate (ad es. marciapiedi, attraversamenti, piste ciclabili, illuminazione)
it.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Cattive condizioni della strada o dei percorsi (ad es. buche, detriti, superfici irregolari)
it.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Comportamenti pericolosi di chi guida, di chi va in bici o di chi va a piedi
it.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Affollamento o conflitti con altre persone in strada
it.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Non mi sento affatto in pericolo

fr.#Which of the following situations on a: Parmi les situations suivantes, lesquelles vous semblent dangereuses pendant un déplacement ? (les plus importantes)
fr.#Heavy or fast-moving traffic: Trafic dense ou véhicules roulant vite
fr.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Manque d’infrastructures sûres ou adaptées (par ex. trottoirs, traversées, pistes cyclables, éclairage)
fr.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Routes ou chemins en mauvais état (par ex. nids-de-poule, débris, surfaces irrégulières)
fr.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Mauvaise visibilité ou champ de vision limité
fr.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Comportement dangereux de personnes en voiture, à deux-roues ou à pied
fr.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Forte affluence ou conflits avec d’autres personnes qui circulent
fr.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Je ne me sens jamais en danger

de.#Which of the following situations on a: Welche der folgenden Situationen empfinden Sie während eines Weges als unsicher? (die wichtigsten)
de.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Fehlende sichere oder geeignete Infrastruktur (z. B. Gehwege, Querungen, Radwege, Beleuchtung)
de.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Schlechter Zustand von Straßen oder Wegen (z. B. Schlaglöcher, Schmutz, unebene Flächen)
de.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Gefährliches Verhalten von Autofahrenden, Zweiradfahrenden oder zu Fuß Gehenden
de.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Überfüllung oder Konflikte mit anderen Verkehrsteilnehmenden
de.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht gefährdet

tr.#Which of the following situations on a: Aşağıdaki durumlardan hangilerini yolculuk sırasında tehlikeli buluyorsunuz? (en önemlileri)
tr.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Güvenli veya yeterli altyapının olmaması (ör. kaldırımlar, geçişler, bisiklet yolları, aydınlatma)
tr.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Yol veya patikaların kötü durumda olması (ör. çukurlar, moloz, düzensiz yüzeyler)
tr.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Kötü görüş veya sınırlı görüş mesafesi
tr.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Sürücülerin, iki tekerlekli araç kullanıcılarının veya yayaların tehlikeli davranışları
tr.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Kalabalık veya diğer yol kullanıcılarıyla çatışma

fa.#Which of the following situations on a: کدام یک از موقعیت‌های زیر را در طول سفر خطرناک می‌دانید؟ (مهم‌ترین‌ها)
fa.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: نبود زیرساخت ایمن یا مناسب (مثلاً پیاده‌رو، گذرگاه، مسیر دوچرخه، روشنایی)
fa.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: وضعیت نامناسب خیابان یا مسیر (مثلاً چاله، زباله، سطح ناهموار)
fa.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: دید ضعیف یا میدان دید محدود
fa.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: رفتار خطرناک رانندگان، موتورسواران، دوچرخه‌سواران یا عابران
fa.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: شلوغی یا برخورد و تعارض با سایر کاربران راه

hu.#Which of the following situations on a: Az alábbi helyzetek közül melyeket tartja veszélyesnek utazás közben? (a legfontosabbak)
hu.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Biztonságos vagy megfelelő infrastruktúra hiánya (pl. járdák, átkelőhelyek, kerékpárutak, világítás)
hu.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Rossz út- vagy járdaviszonyok (pl. kátyúk, törmelék, egyenetlen felületek)
hu.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Rossz látási viszonyok vagy korlátozott beláthatóság
hu.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Járművezetők, kétkerekű járművek használói vagy gyalogosok veszélyes viselkedése

ar.#Which of the following situations on a: أي من المواقف التالية يبدو لك غير آمن أثناء التنقل؟ (الأهم منها)
ar.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: غياب بنية تحتية آمنة أو مناسبة (مثل الأرصفة، المعابر، مسارات الدراجات، الإضاءة)
ar.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: سوء حالة الطريق أو المسار (مثل الحفر أو المخلفات أو الأسطح غير المستوية)
ar.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: ضعف الرؤية أو محدودية مجال النظر
ar.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: سلوك خطير من أشخاص يقودون السيارات أو الدراجات أو يسيرون على الأقدام
ar.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: الازدحام أو التعارض مع أشخاص آخرين يستخدمون الطريق
